tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// karma pa rang byung rdo rje gsung 'bum dkar chag /

༄༅// karma pa rang rdo rje/ 284 - 1339 dpal chos kyi rje karma pa sku phreng gsum pa rang byung rdo rje mchog ni stod lung 'phar tshar du rgan rgon gnyis kyi bu lo bcu gnyis lon pa zhig shi ba'i sdug bsngal la snying rjes gzigs te grong 'jug mdzad kyang rten 'brel ma 'grig /de nas la stod kyi char rje btsun mi la'i 'khrungs yul dang nye ba mang yul gung thang tsa phu zhes bya bar/ lan de gangs zhur mo'i 'gram du yab sngags ston chos dpal dang*/ yum jo g.yang 'dren gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung lnga pa'i shing sprel spyi lo 1284 zla ba dang po'i tshes brgyad la sku 'khrungs/ 'khrungs ma thag zla ba la gzigs te tshes brgyad kyi zla ba red 'dug ces gsung byon pas/ sru mo zhig yod pa de rnam rtog ngan pa shar te skyes ma thag smra shes pa 'di mi legs pas med pa gyis zer te 'tshe ba byas pas/ gsung 'byon pa dang sku bzhengs pa sogs mi nus pa'i tshul gnang*/ dgung lo gsum gyi dus su phying pa nag po'i zhwa nag chung ngu zhig dbu la gsol te rdo'i khri thog nas 'khor gyi byis pa rnams la/ sna tshogs rol pa'i snang ba 'di dag kun// sgyu ma smig sgyu 'ja' tshon ji bzhin du// snang yang bden pas stong pa kho bos rtogs// ma rtogs byis pa khyed rnams snying re rje// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ yab yum 'khor bcas la nga karma pa yin zhes zhal bzhes gnang*/ de nas yab kyi mdun nas zhi byed so lugs kyi brgyud pa dang*/ sngags 'chang ngos nag pa dang*/ dbu rtse pa gnyis las ma mo dang phur pa sogs snga 'gyur gyi chos skor du ma gsan bzhes mdzad/ yi ge 'bri klog kyang sbyang brtson gyi dka' tshegs ma dgos par mkhyen/ dgung lo lngar son pa na grub chen o rgyan pa'i zhal nas sang nga'i bla ma karma pa 'byon par yod gsungs nas stan mthon po bshams te gra bsgrig gnang*/ phyi nyin phebs skabs su gsang bdag gi ting nge 'dzin gyis zil gyi mnan yang ma thub par/

khri thog tu the tshom med par bzhugs pa la o rgyan pa'i zhal nas/ byis pa khyod nga'i bla ma'i gdan la 'dug pa ci yin gsungs par/ khyod kyi bla ma nga yin yang da lta khyed la re dgos par 'dug pas bskyang du gsol zhes gsungs te khri las babs/ de nas o rgyan pas nga'i bla ma'i gsang mtshan rang byung rdo rje yin pas de ka rang 'dogs gsungs te dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang sems bskyed bcas gnang*/ bde mchog /dgyes rdor/ ma mo/ phur pa/ dus 'khor/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba la sogs kyi dbang dang rgyud rnams dang*/ gzhan yang ro snyoms sgang dril dang sku gsum ngo sprod/ bsre 'pho dang*/ khrid chen brgyad dang rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ do ha dang*/ lhan cig skyes sbyor sogs gnang*/ dgung lo bdun lon pa lcags stag 1290 la/ khro phu mkhan po kun ldan shes rab las rab tu byung ste 'dul ba'i bslab bya mtha' dag la byang chub par sbyang pa mdzad/ de nas grub chen gnyan ras kyis mtshur phur gdan zhus bzhin phebs pas ngo mtshar ba'i gzigs snang du ma byung*/ slob dpon shes rab dpal dang*/ rgya sgom ye shes 'od/ gnam mtsho ba sogs la rim bzhin sdud 'grel pañtsi ka dang bshad sbyar/ dgyes rdor dang spyod 'jug /ma cig gi gcod skor rnams gsan/ grub chen gnyan ras mdun mar mi dwags gsum las brgyud pa'i kaṃ tshang gi zab chos mtha' dag dang*/ rngog mtshur mes gsum ras chung pa sogs nas brgyud pa'i gdams khrid rnams rdzogs par gsan/ gsang phu gling smad kyi gdan rabs bco lnga pa 'jam dbyangs shākya gzhon nu'i mdun byams chos sde lnga 'grel ba dang bcas pa/ dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab 'grel pa ga le 'jigs med/ dbu ma rang rgyud shar gsum gyi gzhung dang*/ tshad ma sde bdun yan lag dang bcas pa/ mngon pa gong 'og sa sde dang bcas pa/ 'dul ba 'od ldan/ sgom rim rnam gsum dang jo bo'i chos chung brgya rtsa/ bslab pa kun btus dang mdo sde kun btus/

nyi khri snang ba dang sher snying 'grel ba/ sa lu ljang pa'i mdo 'grel dang rnam par mi rtog pa la 'jug pa'i 'grel ba sogs la gsan bsam gnang*/ mngal bshol gyi zla ba brtsis pa'i dgung lo nyi shu pa lcags glang 1301 la tshogs dge 'dun sgang pa'i mkhan rabs lnga pa gnas brtan gzhon nu byang chub kyis mkhan po dang*/ dge 'dun rin chen gyis las slob gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs/ mtshan tshul khrims gzhon nu zhes gsol/ mkhan po de nyid las 'dul ba lung sde bzhi mdo rtsa ba dang*/ sum brgya pa dang kā ri kā lnga bcu pa/ karma sha staṃ dang sor mdo'i 'grel ba sogs gsan/ snye mdo ba kun dga' don grub las dpal dus kyi 'khor lo rgyud 'grel yan lag dang bcas pa dang*/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba 'byung po 'dul byed dang*/ 'khor lo chen po sdom 'byung gi rgyud 'grel dang*/ gshed mar dgra nag dang gdong drug rgyud kyi sgrub thabs/ rdo rje phreng ba dang mngon 'byung dbang sgrub/ gdan bzhi gur dang saṃ bhu ti'i rgyud 'grel/ gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs dang*/ gsang snying yang dag lung bzhi mkha' 'gro'i skor/ 'jam dpal sku'i sgrub thabs dang pad ma gsung gi sgrub thabs/ phur pa'i dbang dang bka' brgyad kyi dbang yongs rdzogs/ de nyid 'dus pa dang dpal mchog rigs bsdus/ rdo rje rtse mo sbyong rgyud kyi dkyil chog rnams dang*/ gtsug dgu dang rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba/ rdo rje bdud rtsi dang sangs rgyas thod pa/ gsang ldan lha mo gcig sgrub kyi spyi rgyud dang*/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud/ phyag na rdo rje'i dbang bka' rgyud 'grel sgrub thabs phal cher dang*/ sa sde lnga dang mngon pa gong 'og gnyis/ theg bsdus dang sum cu pa/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i mdo sde lnga bcu dang*/ pad ma skor gsum la sogs pa'i mdo mang po zhig gzungs 'dus rgyas pa dang*/ snyan ngag me long ma dang grub mtha' bsdus pa/

zhi byed rgyud pa phyi ma kaṃ lug dang*/ lam 'bras smar lugs dang sbyong drug rigs brgyad/ grub chen o rgyan pa'i bsnyen sgrub kyi gdams pa mtha' dag dang*/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro 'tshal rnams thams cad rdzogs par gsan/ phyis su yang o rgyan pas zhal gzigs te bsnyen sgrub kyi gdams pa rnams rdzogs par gnang*/ mkhas pa rba ras sogs la gso ba rig pa'i skor rnams gsan pa dang*/ skar rtsis kyi sa ris sogs la thugs brtson chen po'i sbyang pa mdzad/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshul khrims rin chen las/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud 'grel bshad rgyud bzhi dang/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ ma hā ma ya/ gur dang*/ gdan bzhi/ me rngog rnam gnyis las rgyud pa'i dgyes rdor rgya gzhung rnams dang*/ gshin rje kha thun gyi sgrub skor gnam lcags ur mo dang*/ 'grel pa gru gzings rin chen sna bdun dang 'jam dpal khro bo 'dus pa/ bde mchog snyan brgyud sogs mar pa dang rngog las brgyud pa'i gdams ngag sgrub yig bka' lung dang bcas pa mtha' dag gsan/ bla ma ku mā ra dza'i mdun rdzogs chen snying thig gsan pas lam rtags kyi yon tan rnams rdzogs te/ paṇa chen bi ma la rang gi mdzod spu la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung te/ rdzogs pa chen po'i sa lam gyi yon tan mtha' dag la mnga' dbang 'byor te karma snying thig gi shing rta'i srol phyes nas rdzogs chen gyi bstan bcos kyang mang po mdzad/ karma lha steng gi ri khrod dang*/ nag phu'i sgrub sde/ dgon gsar lhun grub steng sogs phyag btab/ dbus gtsang dwags kong*/ tsā ri khams phyogs rnams su phebs te de phyogs kyi skye bo dpag tu med par gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde'i dpal la 'god par mdzad/ de nas dgung lo zhe drug pa bod rab byung drug pa'i lcags lug 1331 la/ yon gong ma tho gan the mur 'ja' yā dus kyis gdan zhus lan grangs du ma byung ba bzhin/ chu sprel

1332 la mtshur phu nas mtsho sngon brgyud lam du phebs skabs yon gong ma 'das kyang rin chen dpal gyis phebs bsu sne len byas/ rin chen dpal yang zla ba gcig gi rjes su 'das te gong ma dgu pa tho gan the'i mur khrir gsol gyi mdzad sgo kyang gnang*/ yon gong ma 'khor dang bcas par chos kyis smin par mdzad de lo gcig lhag tsam bzhugs te shing khyi 1334 la bod du phyir phebs te bsam yas mchims phur ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs/ de rjes bka' 'gyur dang*/ bstan 'gyur bzhengs pa'i rab tu gnas mdzad pas byang chub sems dpa' mang pos dam chos sgrogs pa'i gzigs snang shar/ slar yang me byi 1336 la tho gan the'i mur gyis gdan zhus thengs mang byung ba bzhin/ pe cing du phebs skabs gong mas rgya sgo'i mdun nas bsu ba byas/ rgyal po'i don du tshe sgrub sogs rim 'gro mdzad/ pe cing nub tu dgon pa zhig gsar rgyag gnang te dgung grangs lnga bcu nga drug pa sa yos 1339 la zhi bar gshegs/ sku gdung zhugs 'bul zhus te gdung rten rnams mtshur phur gdan 'dren zhus te gdung rten du bzhugs su gsol ba'o// rje 'di nyid kyi gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma'i tshogs/ o rgyan pa'i sprul sku/ bram ze mgon po/ rmog lcog pa/ rtogs ldan bsam rin/ rgyal ba ri khrod pa/ phug po che ba/ lha rje rnam gnyis/ chu sgom pa/ kho ye dge slong*/ rtogs ldan khrag skyug pa/ rtogs ldan mgon rgyal ba/ ye rgyal ba/ lha bu ba kun yas/ ldong ston gzhon nu 'bum/ spyan snga rdor rin pa/ stag lung kun spangs rin po che/ mkhas grub dharma rā dza/ bla ma ngar 'byung*/ slob dpon 'jam nyag /klog skya bka' bzhi ba seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mngon pa ba/ sman lung ba/ dge 'dun sgang pa'i mkhan po mkhas btsun pa sogs mkhas grub rnams dang*/ go shri kun dga' rgyal po/ ta'i dben go'i shri/ sidhu dge sbyong chen po/ bla ma ting 'dzin bzang po sogs mdo dbus khams kong gi gdan sa skyong ba mtha' yas shing*/

khyad par du bstan pa'i bdag po rtogs ldan grags pa seng ge dang*/ zung 'jug gi go 'phang brnyes pa g.yung ston rdo rje dpal/ dol bu pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ tshal pa'i drung chen smon lam rdo rje gsum ni bstan pa gtad sa dang thugs kyi dgongs pa 'pho sa yin/ gzhan yang sku tshe gcig gis mkha' spyod gnas su gshegs pa sgom chen brgya dang brgyad sogs byon pa'o/// / khong gi gsung 'bum ni/ (ka)rtags can la/ sangs rgyas skyes rabs kyi bsdus don/ slob dpon dpa' bo'i mdzad pa'i skyes rabs so bzhi pa/ (kha)rtags can la/ karma pa rang byung rdo rjes mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas kyi skyes rabs/ (ga)rtags can la/ karma pa rang byung rdo rje'i phyogs bsgrigs mdzad pa'i rje btsun mi la ras pa'i mgur 'bum mdzod nag ma/ (nga)rtags can la/ rje btsun tai lo pa nas rang byung rdo rje yan chad kyi bka' brgyud gser phreng gi bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar gyi skor las/ grub pa'i dbang phyug tai lo pa dang nā ro pa'i rnam thar/ mi la rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ ngan rdzong ras pa'i rnam thar/ rgyal sras zla 'od gzhon nu'i rnam thar/ dus gsum mkhyen pa seng ge sgra yi rnam thar/ 'gro mgon ras pa chen po dang rin po che spom brag pa'i rnam thar/ bla ma rin po che karma pakshi'i rnam thar/ dpal u rgyan pa'i rnam thar/ dpal chen rang byung rdo rje'i rnam thar/ thams cad mkhyen pa rin po che rang byung rdo rje'i rnam par thar pa tshigs su bcad pa/ chos rje rang byung rdo rje'i thugs dam bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag /bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi dkar chag / (ca)rtags can la/ gsol 'debs skor la/ bka' bzhi rgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ sbyor drug rgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje bskul ba'i gsol 'debs/ bstod tshogs kyi skor la/ phag mo shes rab snang ba'i bstod pa/

bcom ldan 'das mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi phrin las phyogs cig la bstod pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi yon tan gyi cha shas la bstod pa/ dpal kun tu bzang po la bstod cing smon lam btab pa zhes bya ba/ mtshur phu'i bstod pa/ dben gnas bde chen gyi bstod pa/ dus bzhi gnas la bsngags pa/ rong btsan kha ba dkar po'i bstod pa/ mtshur phu'i bstod pa thung ba/ springs yig zhal gdams kyi skor la/ ri chos dngos grub phreng ba/ ang yig dang ka rtsom tshigs su bcad pa gnyis/ gsang phu pa la springs pa/ rgyal ba ye shes la springs pa/ lha steng pa gzhon nu 'bum la springs pa/ rab sgang pa grags pa rgyal mtshan la springs pa/ dpal 'bum la gdams pa/ rmi lam gyi tshigs bcad/ rtogs pa brjod pa tshigs su bcad pa/ theg pa mtha' dag gi don gsal ba/ u rgyan pa mnal lam du mjal lugs/ yar lha sham por gsungs pa/ sems 'khrul tshul brjod pa/ bdud ngos 'dzin bco lnga pa/ bsam gtan gyi skyon ngos 'dzin/ bstan bcos thor bu brgyang cu rtsa gnyis pa/ rang byung rdo rje'i gsung mgur phyogs sdebs/ gzhan gyi rgyud la phan pa'i khrims yig /'khor ba la nges par 'byung ba rang la gros 'debs zhes bya ba/ 'od dpag med la bstod pa zhing mchog sgo 'byed/ yang gsung mgur thor bu ba 'ga' zhig la/ dga' ldan lha'i mdo/ chos mngon pa'i phung po lnga'i rab tu byed pa'i gzhung*/ dam pa'i chos dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i bsdus don/ dam pa'i chos dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i mdo yi don gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos/ (cha)rtags can la/ dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i bstan bcos kyi 'grel pa/ sdud pa tshigs su bcad pa'i sa bcad/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sdud pa tshigs su bcad pa'i ṭikka yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che pha rol tu phyin pa rgya mtsho'i sde zhes bya ba/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi sa bcad snang byed sgron me gzhung dang bcas pa/

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa skabs brgyad stong thun/ chos dang chos nyid rnam par 'byed pa'i bstan bcos kyi rnam par bshad pa'i rgyan ces zhes bya ba/ (ja)rtags can la/ dbu ma chos dbyings bstod pa'i rnam par bshad pa la/ theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos kyi 'grel pa gsal ba nyi ma'i snying po zhes bya ba/ rlung sems gnad kyi lde mig /rnam shes dang ye shes bstan pa'i bstan bcos/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po bstan pa'i sa bcad/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po bstan pa'i bstan bcos/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po gtan la dbab pa'i bstan bcos mchan can/ zab mo nang don gyi gzhung*/ gsang sngags zab mo nang don gyi 'grel pa/ (nya)rtags can la/ dam tshig rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa rnam par snang bar byed pa dri ma med pa'i snying po zhes bya ba/ mkha' 'gro ma kun tu spyod pa'i sa bcad/ mkha' 'gro ma kun tu spyod pa'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa/ dpal brtag pa gnyis pa'i sa bcad/ dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i rnam par bshad pa drang ba dang nges pa'i don gsal bar byed pa dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba brtag pa dang po'i 'grel ba/8 dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i rnam par bshad pa drang ba dang nges pa'i don gsal bar byed pa dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba brtag pa gnyis pa'i 'grel ba/ (ta)rtags can la/ rnal 'byor gsum gyi snying po gsal ba'i 'grel pa/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs phyi nang gzhan gsum gsal ba zhes bya ba/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang gi cho ga /shrī ma hā ma ya'i mngon rtogs dang gtor ma'i cho ga /dpal padma rgyal po'i rgyud kyi bsdus don dang*/ padma zab pa'i rgyud kyi bsdus don/ padma zab pa'i rgyud kyi mngon rtogs/ thugs rje chen po padma zab pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi man ngag /thugs rje chen po'i bzlas pa'i man ngag /padma snang ba'i dbang gi cho ga gsal bar byed pa/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs dang*/

bcom ldan 'das padma zab pa'i mngon rtogs tshig lhug ma/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang chog dri ma med pa'i don bsdus/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang chog /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang bskur dang tshogs mchod kyi lag len/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sgo nas sgrib pa sbyong ba/ dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i snying po'i mngon par rtogs pa/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbang gi cho ga /shes rab snang ba'i sgrub thabs phag mo dkar mo'i me mchod dang*/ dpal dril bu pas mdzad pa'i gzhung gsum gyi sa bcad/ dril bu pa'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor/ dril bu pa'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi yig sna/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'thad pa lung sbyor/ dkyil 'khor kyi de kho na nyid snang ba dha ri ka pa'i bzhed pa/ dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i snying po bzlas thabs bcas la/ dpal lu hi pas mdzad pa'i bsgrub thabs kyi bsdus don dang*/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i mngon rtogs lu hi pa'i bzhed pa/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi mngon rtogs nag po pa'i bzhed pa bcas la/ (tha)rtags can la/ dpal nag po pas mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga'i lag len rab tu gsal byed/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i mngon rtogs lha bcu gsum ma/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i mchod phreng/ bde mchog lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang chog /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskang ba dang bshags pa/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i mngon rtogs tshig bcad ma dang*/ dgyes pa rdo rje lha dgu'i mngon rtogs tshig lhug ma/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i lus dkyil/ yig brgya khro bcu bsdus pa/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i mchod khrigs/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i dbang chog bdag med ma'i bskyed rdzogs sogs la/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bsdus don dri ma med pa'i don gyi tshul gsal bar byed pa'i rgyan/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i mngon par rtogs pa rnam dag snang ba/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa lus kyi dkyil 'khor kṣas bskyed pa/

dus kyi 'khor lo'i mngon rtogs tshig bcad ma/ rdo rje shugs kyis sgrub thabs/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i gtor ma/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang gi cho ga gsal bar byed pa/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i mngon rtogs kyi yan lag sbyin bsreg gi lag len ye shes 'od kyi dra ba/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa'i cho ga /dus kyi 'khor lo nas btus pa'i spos sbyor re'u mig /dpal lha mo me lce 'bar ba'i gling gzhi'i rgyud kyi bsdus don dang*/ lha mo'i phyag rgya/ lha mo'i 'chams bcas la/ rab tu gnas pa bum pa gnyis pa/ yul nyer bzhi'i ngos 'dzin/ zab lam nā ro chos drug gi gsal byed spyi chings khrid yig dang bcas pa/ 'khor lo lnga ma/ man ngag gi rim chos/ (a)rtags can la/ sku gsum ngo sprod/ gnas lugs gsal byed ye shes sgron me/ spyir sgom chos rje rang byung rin po che'i zin thun/ phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid yig /rnal 'byor gsum gyi snying po gsal ba/ rnal 'byor gsum gyi khrid yig /rje mi la bzhad pa rdo rje'i gsang ba'i mgur gyi rdo rje'i tshigs rkang sbas don lta ba'i mig 'byed/ ro snyom sgang 'dril/ phyag rgya chen po gaṅgā ma'i gzhung gi sa bcad/ phyag rgya chen po gaṅgā ma'i 'grel pa/ rgyal po do ha'i sa bcad dang*/ btsun mo do ha'i sa bcad/ do ha mdzod kyi bsdus don bcas la/ do ha mdzod kyi glu yi don gsal bar byed pa'i tshig gi rgyan dri ma med pa'i sgron me/ gcod kyi bka' tshoms chen mo'i sa bcad/ gcod kyi ṭikka/ gcod kyi khrid yig /ma ṇi'i bstan bcos dang*/ yi ge drug pa'i bsngags pa/ rdzogs pa chen po'i snying thig spros bcas kyi dbang lce btsun gyis mdzad pa dang*/ rdzogs pa chen po'i dbang gsum pa/ dbang bzhi'i dus dang mtshan ma bstan pa'i phra thig bcas la/ nyams len lag khrid ma'i khrid ngo mtshar can la/ sman gyi bstan bcos sman ming rgya mtsho la/

rlung dang rig pa'i bcud len/ chu 'thung ba'i gdams pa/ ra mo shag gis bcud len/ dbang lag gi bcud len/ 'od ldan sngo'i bcud len/ ya ma spyi 'joms man ngag drug pa bcas la/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag snang ba/ lnga bsdus dang gza' lnga'i rtsis dang*/ dhru ba 'pho ba'i rtsis/ phyi nang gi rtsis/ nyi khyim 'pho ba/ dhru ba sgra gcan 'pho ba dang gza' lnga bsdus pa/ rgyu skar dus kyi pho nya sogs la/ nges don phyag rgya chen po'i smon lam/ dge bsnyen rdo rje chen po'i gtor 'bul/ dam can skyes bu'i las byang dang mngon rtogs rnams so/ ༈ /gong gi (cha)rtags can nang bzhugs dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i bstan bcos kyi 'grel pa mdzad pa po ni/ rje rang byung rdo rje'i slob ma ste kaṃ tshang chos 'byung rab 'byams zla ba nor bu chu shel ldeb 135 las/ mkhas pa shes rab rin chen ni kong por rje rang byung ba'i zhabs la thug cing phyis lha steng du bzhugs nas rje'i rnam thar mdzad pa po de'o zhes pa las rnam thar rgyas pa ni ma rnyed// (ja)rtags can nang bzhugs pa theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos kyi 'grel pa gsal ba nyi ma'i snying po zhes bya ba 'di ni rje rang byung pas mdzad pa la dul mo chos rje bkra shis 'od zer gyis cung zad kha gsal du mdzad pa yin kyang*/ da lta rje rang byung pa'i gsung dngos ma rnyed stabs 'dir tshab byas te bzhag yod/ ༈ dwags po rab 'byams pa mkhas grub chos rgyal bstan pa/ 1449 - 1524 khong gi mtshan gyi rnam grangs la/ dwags po rab 'byams pa mkhas grub chos rgyal bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ phyag chen pa klong yangs rab 'byams sogs zhu/ khong ni rab byung brgyad pa'i sa sbrul 1449 lor sgam po'i mdun nyag nyi klung du sku bltams/ sku chung ngu nas gtsang chen chos rje'i drung du rab tu byung*/ mtshan chos rgyal bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ chos dang gdams ngag mang du gsan/

gsang phu ne'u thog tu dbu tshad phar phyin 'dul mngon bcas mdo phyogs kyi gzhung rnams la gsan bsam mdzad/ phyis skyed tshal du kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel gyi spyan sngar yang mdo sde snod mtha' dag la sbyangs/ lhag par dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel bu lugs kyi phyag len sogs la ches mkhas pa dang*/ phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi sbyor ba'i rtsis la yang mkhas/ sku gzugs mchod rten sogs kyi dbyibs dang cha tshad sogs bzo rig pa'i skor la mkhyen pa phul du phyin te 'chad rtsod rtsom pa la 'gran zla bral/ rtsed thang du grwa skor la byon dus chu byang pa'i dge bshes pod chen brgyad bcu yod pa gcig dang*/ 'bum rab 'byams pa rin chen chos dbang ste rnam gsum lhan cig du byung ba la/ rje 'dis pu ti nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bshad pa mdzad/ khyad par dus kyi 'khor lo la mkhas pa phul du phyin pas der rgyu skar gyi nang nas zla ba ltar lhag par gyur te mtshan snyan rgyas/ de nas rje bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i mdun nas kaṃ tshang gi zab chos mtha' dag gsan pas nyams rtogs kyi rtsal yongs su rdzogs shing 'khrul zhig gi rnal 'byor pa chen po zhig tu gyur/ rje rgyal ba'i dbang po chos grags rgya mtshos kyang thun mong ma yin pa'i sras su dgongs te zhwa ljang gi cod paṇa dang*/ rje mthong ba don gyi phyag dril sogs gnang*/ rje phrin las pas yer pa'i bla mar gsol ba btab ngor yer pa'i gdan sa pa mdzad/ zab mo nang don gyi 'grel pa sogs bstan bcos du ma mdzad/ rje brgyad pas kyang sngags brjod che bar gnang*/ rje btsun gtsug lag phreng bas thub chen du spyan drangs te bla ma dge bshes ches mang po 'dus pa la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dang*/ rje chos grags rgya mtsho nas brgyud pa'i gzhung khrid man ngag mtha' dag gsan/ dgung lo don drug pa rab byung dgu pa'i shing sprel 1524 la mya ngan las 'das/

slob ma dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba dang*/ sgar chen gyi bla mar bskos pa'i dbang gis sgar gyi dpon che chung thams cad kyi bla mar gyur cing*/ grub chen pakshi'i bka' 'bum gyi ljags lung chab dgon pa dang slob dpon bstan pa rgya mtsho gnyis la gnang*/ de gnyis kyi mdun nas rje phrin las pas gsan pa sogs bka' drin shin tu che ba'o/ ༈ /rang byung rdo rje'i gsung 'bum gyi rjes 'brel zab mo nang don gyi 'grel ba phyogs sgrig gi skor las/ (oṃ)rtags can dwags ram pa chos rgyal bstan pas mdzad pa/ dpal rdo rje'i tshig zab mo nang gi don gyi 'grel bshad sems gyi rnam par thar pa gsal bar byed pa'i rgyan/ ༈ ngo khro rab 'byams pa dbang phyug dpal ni/ dus rabs bco lnga pa'i smad tsam du byon pa zhig ste/ de yang rje chos grags rgya mtsho sku na chung ngu'i dus ngo khror phebs skabs zhabs la gtug /chos grags rgya mtshos gser mdog can du slob gnyer la mngags pa bzhin byon te/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan mdun nas mdo sngags kyi gsung rab mtha' dag la sbyangs pa mdzad pas mkhyen rab kyi padmo rgyas/ zhwa dmar spyan snga rin po che las grub rnying gi skor sogs gsan/ ber can sogs chos skyong rnams rgyun par zhal gzigs/ zab mo nang don gyi 'grel pa sogs bstan bcos kyang du ma mdzad/ slob ma'ang bzhag bla ma kun dga' dpal dang*/ mkhan chen shākya bzang po/ g.ya' bzang spyan snga/ bla ma tshe dbang rgya mtsho/ rje blo gros dbang phyug sogs du ma byon pa'o/ ༈ /rang byung rdo rje'i gsung 'bum gyi rjes 'brel zab mo nang don gyi 'grel ba phyogs sgrig gi skor las/ (hūm̐)rtags can ngo khro rab 'byams pas mdzad pa zab mo nang gi don rnam par bshad pa'i bstan bcos kyi tshig don gsal bar byed pa'i legs bshad nor bu rin po che'i phreng ba/ ༈ karma phrin las phyogs las rnam rgyal ni/ 1456 - 1539

dgyer gyi gdung rigs rgyal chen sku rabs pa'i zhal ngo yab 'brug mda' dge sbyong gi sras su rab byung brgyad pa'i me byi 1456 lo dwags por sku bltams/ rje bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi rus dbon yin/ sku chung ngu'i dus zur mkhar du bzhugs te dharma swā mi las sman dpyad dang*/ pho gcod brul tsho drug dang rnying ma'i chos skor rnams zhus/ dgung lo bcu bdun la gnas brtan lhun grub bzang po'i drung nas rab tu byung*/ spyan snga chos kyi grags pa'i drung nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ de yi phyi nyin nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi slob dpon mdzad dgos pa byung*/ sangs rgyas 'phel ba las dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed sogs zhus/ sha ra rab 'byams pa las/ ni gu chos drug dang*/ su kha chos drug /ngam rdzong snyan rgyud sogs gsan/ dwags po paṇa chen don grub rgyal mtshan dang lhan du 'bras yul rdzong dkar du byon/ kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel dang*/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang*/ paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa rnams bsten te sde snod mtha' dag la mkhas par sbyangs/ gzhan yang slob dpon sangs rgyas mgon po/ mkhan po dge 'dun lhun grub/ don grub rgyal mtshan/ byams gling paṇa chen bsod nams rnam rgyal/ gung dkar rdo rje gdan pa/ paṇa chen bde bzang ba/ 'phags mchog yon tan rgya mtsho/ ras chen dpal 'byor rgya mtsho/ 'khrul zhig sangs rgyas bsam 'grub/ slob dpon sangs rgyas chos grags rnams las phyag chen dang*/ ni gu chos drug bka' gdams glegs bam sogs kyi khrid lung skor dang*/ gur zhal dang*/ phur pa/ phag mo/ 'dus pa sogs rgyud sde'i sgrub thabs rnams dang*/ dbu phar 'dul mdzod sogs mdo phyogs kyi gzhung lugs rnams dang*/ sgra dang sdeb sbyor snyan ngag sum rtags sogs thun mong rig gnas kun la gsan bsam mdzad/ zangs po cher bshad pa'i bgro gleng mang po gnang bar dge bshes thams cad kyis bsngags brjod mdzad pas mtshan snyan rgyas/

gcen chos kyi rgyal mtshan la bkra shis rnam rgyal bka' 'bum lung sogs zhus/ zhwa dmar bzhi pa'i drung nas chos drug gi nyams khrid dang*/ dus 'khor dang dgyes rdor/ bde mchog lū hi pa/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ ber nag can gyi dbang chen dang sgrub skor tshang ma'i lung*/ lha mo dang*/ rnam sras sogs kyi rjes gnang rnams zhus/ chos rgyal lhun por rje chos grags rgya mtsho dang mjal ma thag nas sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes skyes te/ rlung sems gnyis med dang*/ chos drug gi khrid kyi zhu ba phul bas brgyud pa 'dzin par khas len dgos pa'i bka' phebs nas phyag chen dang*/ chos drug gi khrid gnang ste zla ba lngar bshad rim ltar nyams su blangs pas ji skad bshad pa'i myong ba rnams rim par thugs la 'khrungs/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i skor cha tshang*/ dbu ma'i lta khrid/ rang stong gzhan stong mi 'gal bar ston pa'i gzhung chung*/ rje rang byung pa'i bka' 'bum tshang ma'i lung dang*/ zab mo nang don/ snying po bstan pa/ rnam shes ye shes kyi sogs kyi bshad pa/ mkha' 'gro snying thig gi myong khrid/ rngog dkyil bdun dang*/ lnga tshan lnga'i dbang sogs gsan bsam mdzad pas/ rgyud gzhung nas bshad pa'i yon tan mtha' dag rgyud la skyes te rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa ste rdo rje 'chang dngos mthong gi nges shes rnyed/ rje karma phrin las zhes pa'i mtshan gnang ste chos 'khor lhun po'i khri par bskos/ skyabs che 'jam dpal rgya mtsho las gcod khrid nam mkha' sgo 'byed dang*/ gcod khrid rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang khrid sogs gsan/ gzhan yang bla ma don grub rgyal mtshan/ 'brong bu go shri/ si tu bkra shis dpal 'byor/ sprul sku bkra shis don grub/ na lend+ra'i chos rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ smyug la paṇa chen/ steng dkar chos rje blo gros rnam rgyal/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis/

zhwa lu lo chen sogs dus der bzhugs pa'i bshes gnyen mtha' dag bsten te gangs ljongs 'dir bzhugs pa'i dbang khrid gdams pa sogs ma gsan pa med pa mdzad/ phyis karma grwa tshang gi byang 'dren mdzad de legs bshad gling gi chos sde gsar du btab/ rje na rim brgyad pa'i las kyi slob dpon mdzad cing phar tshad 'dul mngon dbu ma sogs gzhung lugs mtha' dag phul/ byang chub gling du rgyud pa grwa tshang btsugs/ chos 'khor lhun por mchod rten chen mo dang*/ ston pa'i sku mtho nyer lnga rgyab yol lha khang dang bcas pa/ deb sngon gyis gtsos pa'i gsungs par mang po dang*/ dpal 'byor don grub gyi gdung rten thog tshad pa/ thub chen chos 'khor gyi gdan sa'i rten brten pa gsar bzhengs mdzad pa lo gnyis nas grub/ 'dul ba gzhi gsum gyi lag len tshul bzhin btsugs/ legs bshad gling du zung 'jug brgyud rim gyi gser sku nyer lnga/ karma rabs brgyad kyi bka' 'bum/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi gsung 'bum sogs bzhengs/ na lend+rar bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi gser sku mi tshad/ sprul sku kun dga' bkra shis kyi gser sku/ sa skya'i bka' 'bum/ bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi bka' 'bum pod bzhi/ btsan dgon du gdung rten gser gdung thog brtsegs gsum pa sogs rten bzhengs mang du mdzad/ smyug lar phebs nas gdan sar shes rab rnam rgyal mkhan por bskos/ rje nyid kun spangs mdzad de theg chen rtser 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis dus 'da' zhing snying po'i nyams bzhes kyi ngang du bzhugs/ mdo sngags kyi bstan bcos mdzad pa'ang po ti bcu phrag lhag tsam bzhugs/ sa skya'i lam 'bras glegs bam ma/ dkar ma/ gnyag ma/ smar ma/ pod nag ma/ dpe mdzod ma la sogs pu sti nyi shu lhag pa'i dbang khrid gnang zhing sa bka' gnyis ka'i bstan pa la phrin las rgya cher mdzad de dgung lo brgyad cu gya bzhi pa rab byung dgu pa'i sa phag spyi lo

1539 la zhi bar gshegs/ 'di pa'i dngos brgyud kyi slob ma spyir mtha' yas kyang gtso bor rje brgyad pa rje mi skyod rdo rje/ rgyal tshab bkra shis rnam rgyal/ si tu bkra shis dpal 'byor/ sgam po'i spyan snga bkra shis rnam rgyal dang*/ sgam po spyan snga bkra shis grags pa/ karma pa'i gdan sa gong 'og bar gsum gyi rin po che sogs skyes chen mang po dang*/ bya 'jam dbyangs bkra shis rnam rgyal/ sa thams rgyal po'i bla ma byang chub bshes gnyen la sogs pa rje nyid kyi rtsa slob rab 'byams smra ba brgya phrag du longs pa/ 'dra bla ma chos kyi 'od zer sogs bka' bcu smra ba'i phrin las can ches mang po/ rje nyid kyi dbon po gzims khang 'og ma'i gdan sa snga phyi dang*/ rin chen brag pa'i bla ma na rim/ shangs nas sku rab chos rje cham dgon pa dang glang lung pa sogs ya 'brog gi bla ma phal mo che/ do bo ri pa snga phyi dang tre che chung sogs sgrub grwa'i bla ma ches mang po/ rje smyug la paṇa chen dang phar slob tshur slob mdzad pas chu shul mkhan po dang*/ gzims dpon kun spangs pa sogs chen po gdung rigs mkhas btsun bzang gsum grub pa sha stag /na lend+ra'i gzims dkyil 'og ma kun mkhyen bkra shis rnam rgyal pa'i gdan sa mdzad cing 'phrang po'i chos rje gser mdog pa dang*/ brag thog chos rje sogs dpal sa skya'i dge bshes ches mang po byon pa rnams so/ ༈ /rang byung rdo rje'i gsung 'bum gyi rjes 'brel zab mo nang don gyi 'grel ba phyogs sgrig gi skor las/ ( tram̐ )rtags can karma phrin las pas mdzad pa zab mo nang don gyi rnam bshad snying po gsal bar byed pa'i nyin byed 'od phreng*/ ༈ zhwa dmar dkon mchog yan lag ni/ 1525 - 1583 khong gi mtshan gyi rnam grangs/ zla ba chos skyes/ dkon mchog yan lag /dkon mchog 'bangs/ gar dbang lnga pa rnams so// khong ni kong po'i sa stod zhol mo'i dga' ldan khang gsar du yab rgyal po mtshan ldan dang*/

yum bsod nams sgrol ma gnyis kyi sras su rab byung dgu pa'i shing bya 1525 lor sku 'khrungs/ 'khrungs ma thag tu yum la gzigs shing bzhad mo mdzad/ yi ge'i sbyor klog dge rgan gyis brda bstan pa tsam gyis legs par mkhyen/ dgung lo bzhi par kā ri ka lnga bcu pa dang*/ zab mo nang don/ sum rtags dag gsum sogs la sbyangs pa mdzad pas tshegs med du mkhyen/ dgung lo bco brgyad par rje brgyad pa'i drung du yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes te mtshan la dkon mchog 'bangs zhes gsol/ zhwa dmar gyi cod paṇa gnang*/ smon 'jug gi sems bskyed kyi sdom pa dang*/ nā ro chos drug gis gtsos bka' lugs kyi zab chos gzhan dag gi dbang lung khrid gsum sogs gsan bsam mdzad/ chos rje mi bskyod rdo rje dang*/ dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba sogs rtsa ba'i bla mar bsten nas bka' brgyud kyi gdams pa ma lus pa gsan bsam mdzad/ chos rje dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje'i rigs bdag tu gyur/ dgung lo nga dgu pa rab byung bcu pa'i chu lug 1583 lor zhi bar gshegs/ khong gi slob ma grags che ba ni karma pa dbang phyug rdo rje/ dpa' bo gtsug lag rgya mtsho/ rgyal tshab grags pa don grub/ si tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ sa skya rtse gdong bdag chen/ stag lung kun dga' bkra shis bcas ris med kyi bla dpon dge bshes sogs shin tu mang*/ khong gi gsung 'bum glegs bam brgyad tsam zhig da lta bzhugs yod/ ༈ /lo chen bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde ni/ 1424 - 1482 khong gi mtshan gyi rnam grangs/ dpal 'byor rgya mtsho/ bsod nams rgya mtsho/ shākya rin chen/ khrim khang lo tsā ba/ gsang mtshan mi bskyod rdo rje sogs zhu/ khong ni ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyi gdung rigs yab rig 'dzin bsod nams 'od zer dang*/ yum dpal ldan 'dzom pa gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bdun pa'i shing 'brug 1424 lor yar klung btsan thang gi khang gsar zhes bya bar 'khrungs/

gsang phu pa brag nag mgon rgyal bas mtshan bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde zhes gsol/ dgung lo bzhi lnga nas klog bslab pas tshegs med du mkhyen/ dgung lo bdun par rong ston smra ba'i seng ge las rab tu byung nas mtshan shākya rin chen du gsol/ nyid kyi sku zhang slob dpon ngag dbang las rnam 'grel dang phar phyin slob gnyer mdzad/ dgung lo bcu gsum pa rtsed thang chos grwar phar tshad kyi bshad pa gsar pa'i dga' ston spel bas 'dus pa thams cad ngo mtshar gyi gnas la bkod/ dpal 'byor rgya mtsho las byams chos/ rigs tshogs/ 'jug pa/ spyod 'jug /bzhi brgya pa/ mngon pa gong 'og sogs gsan/ gzhan yang rong ston shes bya kun rig dang*/ rje bkra shis rnam rgyal/ rngog byang chub dpal ba/ dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer/ mkhan chen kun rgyal/ rin chen rgyal mtshan sogs las zab chos ci rig pa gsan bsam mdzad/ tshogs chen pa'i mkhan po don grub dpal bas bsnyen par rdzogs/ khams su 'phul sdud la 'byon pa'i phyir 'jam dbyangs don grub 'od zer las nyer mkho'i dbang lung 'ga' re zhu ba la byon pas/ mkhyen rtogs kyi yon tan la mgu ste zab mo nang don sogs zab chos thams cad zhus pas nang don la zin bris mdzad/ 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal las lo tsā bslabs/ paṇa chen nags rin las bde mchog me tri bcu gsum ma dang*/ dus 'khor gyi dbang dang sbyor drug gi khrid/ ārya de ba'i snying po brgya pa rnams gsan/ dri med 'od kyi dka' gnad rnams la 'dri gtugs mdzad/ zhwa dmar spyan snga las phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor dang*/ nā ro chos drug gi smin khrid sogs gsan bsam rgya cher mdzad/ phar la'ang rngog dkyil bdun sogs phul/ bal yul du phebs nas paṇa chen rin po che las sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang gi ye shes brnyes/ sbyor drug gi man ngag thams cad bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang*/ shānti pu ri shā wa ri pas byin gyis brlabs pa las byung ba'i sbyor drug gi zab khrid kyang phul ba sogs dpon slob thun mong min par gyur/

rtsed thang dang*/ bsam gtan gling*/ pho brang yum bu bla mkhar/ rgyal bzangs/ bsam yas mchims phu/ khrims khang gling*/ brag lha klu phug la sogs par sku mtshams la bzhugs/ phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa phyin ci ma log pa thugs la 'khrungs/ gro bo lung du rje mar pas zhal gzigs/ thugs dam gyi mthil ni dus 'khor kho nar mdzad/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs pa dge 'dun gyi sde la bsnyen bkur mdzad pa'i tshul mtha' yas/ paṇa chen gyi gsung chos gnang ba mang po'i lo tsā dang*/ snying po brgya pa rtsa 'grel dang rdo rje phag mo'i gzhung*/ rdo rje rnam par sgeg ma gsar 'gyur dang*/ kyai rdor/ gur/ sdom 'byung*/ sdom pa'i 'grel pa sogs 'gyur bcos mdzad/ mthar dgung lo nga dgu pa rab byung brgyad pa'i chu stag 1482 lo'i zla ba dgu par dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim/ thugs sras kyi thu bo zhwa dmar bzhi pa chos grags ye shes dang*/ mi nyag rab 'byams pa chos kyi grags pa/ rab 'byams pa bde bzang*/ mnga' ris rab 'byams pa sher rgyal ba/ chos rje rte'u ra ba rin chen chos rgyal sogs mang po byung ba'o/ ༈ /rang byung rdo rje'i gsung 'bum gyi rjes 'brel zab mo nang don gyi 'grel ba phyogs sgrig gi skor las/ (hrīḥ)rtags can la/ zhwa dmar dkon mchog yan lag gis mdzad pa zab mo nang don gyi mchan bu mngon sum lam byed/ zab mo nang don gyi rnam bshad mthong bas khong du chud pa zhes bya ba/ bstan bcos zab mo nang don gyi gtong thun rab gsal nyi ma'i snying po zhes bya ba/ khrims khang lo tsā bas mdzad pa zab mo nang gi yang snying gsang ba gsum gyi gnad rnam par phye ba zhes bya ba'i zin bris/ ༈ kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho ni/ 1813 - 1899 khong gi mtshan gyi rnam grangs/ karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho/ blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sde/ padma gar gyi dbang phyug phrin las 'gro 'dul rtsal/ bstan gnyis g.yung drung gling pa/

khong ni mdo khams 'bri zla zal mo sgang gi char gnas mchog padma lha rtse'i mdun rol rong rgyab sbas pa'i yul du yab khyung po bla ma g.yung drung dang*/ yum bkra shis mtsho bya ba'i sras su/ rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i chu bya 1813 lo zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu la sku 'khrungs/ zhe chen paṇa chen 'gyur med mthu stobs rnam rgyal dang*/ dpal spungs si tu padma nyin byed dbang po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po sogs ris med kyi skye chen lnga bcu tsam bsten nas phyi tha snyad rig gnas yan lag dang bcas pa/ nang mdo rgyud gsar rnying dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa/ gsang ba man ngag nyams khrid phyag bzhes dang bcas pa rnams la thos pas mtha' rgya bcad/ bsam pas gtan la phab/ sgom pas nyams su blangs te rang don du ji lta ji snyed kyi mkhyen pa'i ye shes mngon du gyur/ gzhan don du gdul bya rang rang gi mos blo dang 'tshams par sgra ka tsan dbyangs gsum dang*/ sum rtags dag gsum/ gso rig rgyud bzhi/ skar nag rtsis sogs tha snyad rig gnas skor dang*/ gzhung chen bcu gsum/ sgyu 'phrul gsang snying*/ nā ro chos drug /sbyor drug sogs mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad lan grangs du mar gnang ste skal ldan rnams rjes su bzung*/ khyad par gso ba rig pa'i skor la mdzad rjes thun mong ma yin pa bskrun/ dam pa 'di nyid kyis rtsom bsgrigs gnang ba'i mdzod chen rnam lngas gtsos glegs bam dgu bcu tsam rjes 'jug rnams la bstan rgyun du legs par bstsal te dgung grangs brgyad cu gya bdun pa rab byung bco lnga'i sa phag 1899 lor zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes nyer brgyad nyin gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos kyi dbyings su bsdu bar mdzad/ gang gi gsung gi gsang bar rol pa'i thugs sras karma pa sku phreng bcu bzhi pa dang bco lnga pa/ tā yi si tu sku phreng bcu pa dang bcu gcig pa*/ 'jam dbyangs blo gter dbang po/ chos rje kun dka' 'jam dbyangs/

mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal/ gter ston las rab gling pa/ kaḥthog si tu chos kyi rgya mtsho/ dpal yul rgya sprul padma mdo sngags bstan 'dzin/ rgyud smad mkhan po ye shes gong 'phel/ brag g.yab gdong sprul ngag dbang dam chos rgya mtsho sogs dbus gtsang mdo khams stod smad bar gsum gyi sa dge bka' rnying gi mkhas grub shin tu mang po byon pa'o/ ༈ /karma pa mkha' khyab rdo rje ni/ 1870 - 1921 khong gi mtshan gyi rnam grangs/ don grub rdo rje/ dpal ldan kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma chen po phrin las mkha' khyab rdo rje phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde/ khong ni gtsang myang stod shel dkar rgyal rtser yab snyan grags dbang po dang*/ yum skal bzang sgrol ma gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bco lnga pa'i lcags rta 1870 lor sku 'khrungs/ sku na chung dus mtshan la don grub rdo rje zhes gsol/ dgung lo lnga par yi ge'i sbyor klog legs par mkhyen/ dgung lo drug par sku gong ma'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin mdzad de 'og min mtshur phur gdan drangs te khrir gsol mdzad/ mtshan la dpal ldan kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma chen po 'phrin las mkha' khyab rdo rje phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde zhes gsol/ 'brug thams cad mkhyen pa dang*/ yongs 'dzin shes bya kun mkhyen gnyis las rab tu byung*/ dgung lo brgyad par rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho dang mjal 'phrad mdzad pas shis brjod dang gzengs bstod gnang*/ mkhan chen bkra shis 'od zer las bka' 'gyur gyi lung dang*/ dpa' bo gtsug lag nyin byed las 'ja' tshon pod drug gi dbang lung*/ sngags grwa rig 'dzin chen po las si tu kun mkhyen bka' 'bum sogs kyi dbang lung khrid gsum dang*/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang po las dkar po rnam gsum gyi dbang lung sogs gsan bzhes mdzad/ 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas mdun rin chen gter mdzod kyi dbang lung khrid gsum dang*/

shes bya kun khyab/ dbu ma 'jug pa/ mngon rtogs rgyan/ rgyud bla ma/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud/ gsang 'dus/ dri med 'od/ sgyu 'phrul gsang ba snying po rnams kyi bshad khrid gsan te thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu phyin/ khong gis si tu'i mchog sprul dang*/ 'brug chen mchog sprul/ 'jam mgon kong sprul gyi yang srid khri 'don legs par mdzad/ mtshur phur dge 'dun zur re'i 'du khang gsar rgyag dang*/ pho brang nyam gso/ lha sa'i gtsug lag khang du tshe ring mched lnga'i rten dang skong gso dang lha gsol rgyun 'dzugs mdzad/ khong ni sku tshe gang bor mnga' ris dang*/ dbus gtsang*/ dwags kong*/ 'bras ljongs/ lho mon/ spu kong*/ byang 'brog /mdo khams/ rgya 'jang*/ hor sog tshun du zhabs kyis bcags te gsung gi bdud rtsis skye bo mchog dman bgrangs kyis mi langs par gtan bde smin grol gyis tshims par mdzad/ mthar dgung lo lnga bcu nga gcig pa rab byung bco lnga pa'i lcags bya 1921 lor sku gshegs/ slob ma si tu sprul sku/ rgyal tshab sprul sku/ dpa' bo'i sprul sku/ tre ho gar dbang*/ khra leb sprul sku sogs mang du byon pa'o// khong gi gsung rtsom ni lha rtse'i dge slong 'jam dpal tshul khrims kyis bka' bsdu mdzad pas po ti bcu skor tsam yod/ ༈ bya bral ba rin chen bzang po ni dus rab bco lnga'i smad du byon pa zhig ste/ khong ni khrims khang lo tsā ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i slob ma yin zhing rnam thar ni da sngon nga tshos mjal rgyu ma byung*/ ༈ rang byung rdo rje'i gsung 'bum gyi rjes 'brel zab mo nang don gyi 'grel ba phyogs sgrig gi skor las/ (āḥ)rtags can la bya bral ba rin chen bzang pos mdzad pa zab mo nang gi don gyi rnam par bshad pa'i zin bris lo chen zhal lung*/ kong sprul yon tan rgya mtshos mdzad pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i snying po bsdus pa zab mo nang gi don nyung ngu'i tshig gis rnam par 'grel ba zab don snang byed/

karma pa mkha' khyab rdo rjes mdzad pa zab mo nang gi don gsal bar ston pa'i gzhung bde blag tu rtogs par byed pa'i mchan 'grel rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal lung nor bu rnam par snang ba dri ma med pa'i 'od/ rang byung rdo rje'i bka' 'bum po ti bcu gcig /zab mo nang don gyi 'grel ba phyogs sgrig po ti lnga/ khyon bsdoms po ti bcu drug bzhugs/// /rang byung rdo rje'i gsung da skabs ma rnyed pa ma 'ongs par 'tshol dgos pa'i mtshan tho// thub pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis/ mdo rgya chen rol pa nas btus pa'i skyes rabs/ 'dul ba las byung ba'i skyes rabs/ bstan rtsis/ mdo phal po che'i bsdus don/ 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i sa bcad/ sangs rgyas kyi snying rje chen po bstan pa'i bsdus don/ 'phags pa byams pa la 'jug pa'i mdo yi bsdus don/ 'phags pa chos kyi tshul gyi bsdus don/ 'phags pa rmad du byung ba'i mdo yi bsdus don/ mdo sde rgyan gyi bsdus don/ dbus dang mtha' rnam par 'byed pa'i 'grel pa dang bsdus don/ theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bsdus don/ byang sa dang*/ nyan rang gi sa'i bsdus don/ mdo sde tshangs pa'i dra ba las 'jigs tshogs la lta ba drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi sdom/ 'phags pa rdo 'phang pa'i mdo'i bsdus don/ dpal ldan ma'i zhus pa'i bsdus don/ stong pa nyid kyi rnam grangs gsal bar byed pa/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i gzungs kyis bsdus don/ bstan pa rgya mtsho'i spyi gzhung chen mo'i bsdus don gsal byed sgrol ma/ chos nyid rnam 'byed kyi bsdus don/ rgyud lugs kyi rnam thar/ sa ra ha yi rnam thar/ dpal karma pa'i rnam thar bcu drug la bstod pa/ rin po che rang byung rdo rje dgung lo drug bzhes pa'i dus su la stod pu trar bla ma u rgyan pa'i drung du gsung pa'i rnam thar/ rnam thar rgya yul ma/ byang sems rgyal ba ye shes kyi rnam thar/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan mdo sde skal pa bzang po las byung ba/

sna tshogs dpe bum/ gsang sngags nang gi gtor ma/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i 'grel pa/ gsal byed mu tig phreng ba'i snying po las skyabs 'gro/ bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa len pa'i thabs/ sems bskyed/ bsngo ba smon lam dang bcas pa/ gnyis med rnam rgyal gyi mngon rtogs/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa dang rnam rgyal gyi dkyil chog rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi cho ga phyag rdor gtum chung gi mngon rtogs/ 'phags pa gdugs dkar gyi cho ga /gtsug tor dri med kyi gzungs chog dpal mgon po'i las byang*/ dpal lha mo'i las byang*/ mgon po'i bskang ba/ rdor legs bskang ba/ bde gshegs thugs dril gyi las byang*/ 'dul ba'i las chog bsam gtan gyi man ngag byang chub kyi phyogs dang mthun pa rnam rtog rtsal sbyong*/ sems gnas pa'i bzhag thabs dgu dang yid la mi byed pa bcu gcig gsal byed*/ myur ba'i lcags yig brtson 'grus kyi lcags yig tshigs bar brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ thugs rje chen po'i 'pho ba/ phyag rgya bzhi yi rim pa/ rgyud gsum pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi man ngag bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag thabs bzhi chos kyi 'khor lo'i 'grel pa/ theg pa che chung gi sgom thabs/ sgyu ma sum rgyud/ bar do'i gdams pa/ rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub/ gtum mo gangs kyi seng chen ma/ lta sgom 'brel pa bzhi ldan/ rnal 'byor gsum gyi snying po gsal ba'i gegs sel gyi gdams pa/ dmar zhabs kyi khrid yig bcud len gyi man ngag zab mo'i skor/ sngags 'bum rin chen gsal byed/ shin tu zab pa'i man ngag rin po che bdud rtsi'i bum bzang*/ dug nad bcos pa'i man ngag /bzhes 'bod rlung nag 'tshub ring*/ snying gtam tshigs cig ma/ do ha'i lo rgyus/ las lag gi 'grel pa/ rje nyid kyi lhan cig skyes pa de kho na nyid kyi snang ba/ man ngag tshig bsdus/ rnam rtog rtsal sbyong*/ lta sgom 'brel ba bzhi ldan gyi don bshad pa'i man ngag

/spyan ras gzigs kyi sgo nas/ 'pho ba'i man ngag /phyag rgya bzhi'i rim pa bshad pa'i man ngag /rgyud 'bum nas gsungs pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi man ngag zab mo'i don bshad pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ gcod kyi khrid nyams bu len pa'i man ngag gi khrid yig bdud ngos 'dzin bco lnga pa zhes bya ba'i tshigs bcad dang po/ sgyu ma sum rgyud ces bya ba/ bar du gsum gyi gdams pa zhes bya ba/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i 'grel pa/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i gegs sel gyi gdams pa/ bka' brgyud kyi chos kyi dkar chag gsal bar byed pa'i gzhung*/ bar do'i rnam thar bstan pa/ karma pa'i rnam thar/ bstan rtsis kyi rnam bzhag /te phu ba'i tshe sgrub 'phros don dang bcas pa dang*/ tshe dpag med dang*/ sgrol ma'i man ngag tshe sgrub zab mo/ gnyis med rnam rgyal gyi mchod phreng*/ sna tshogs dpe bum du grags pa la dang po/ yan lag bdun pa'i tshigs su bcad pa la/ phyag 'tshal rgyas pa dang bcas pa/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i mdo/ bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi mdo/ maṇḍal gyi cho ga brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa/ spyan ras gzigs rgya ba rgya mtsho'i gsang sgrub/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma hrīḥbaskyed ma/ lha lnga ma'i sgom thabs kyi man ngag gtor ma'i cho ga dang bcas pa/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal gnyis ma'i sgom thabs/ dpal mgon po ber nag can gyi sgrub thabs/ gtor chog dang bcas pa/ dpal ldan lha mo'i sgrub thabs gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long zhes bya ba'i gdams pa/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyi sgrub thabs kyi man ngag /gtor ma brgya rtsa gsol 'debs dang bcas pa'i skor rnams dang*/ mgon po'i las byang zhes bya ba mgon po sgrub cing mchod pa'i thabs/ las byang gsal ba'i me long*/ mgon po'i bskang ba/ mdo phal po che las btus pa'i smon lam 'grub tshul la sogs pa brjod pa'i man ngag rnams so/// /
